transcript.t: Today we talk about frogs. A frog begins its life in water as a tiny egg.
After about ten days, the egg becomes a small tadpole with a long tail. It swims and eats plants.
After some weeks, the tadpole grows two back legs, and later two front legs. Its tail slowly gets shorter.
At last, it becomes a young frog and moves onto land.
Frogs eat insects, so they help farmers. They are also a sign of a clean environment.
We should protect the ponds where frogs live.
